question: What benefits does the inspection of all people in these places bring?
premises: The verse refers to the act of seeing or inspecting all people.
This inspection is characterized as bringing results in this world.
This inspection is also characterized as bringing results in the other world.
inference: Therefore, the inspection of all people in these places yields both worldly and other-worldly benefits.
uncertainties: The exact nature of 'īkṣaṇaṃ' (ritual gaze, inspection, or consideration) depends on the broader ritual context.
plain_english: Indeed, the seeing of all brings benefits both in this world and in the world beyond.
